title: A1 AutoVLA driving table sources (2026-10-23)
event_name_rename_neutral: rule-rejected high-FDE plan: Y = 1[A=0 and FDE_5s > 3 m] (paper_body.tex Sec. 3 'Outcomes at each level'; earlier internal names 'severe' / 'amplification' / 'A- AND FDE5>3m')

horizons.severe/ADE/FDE: 5 s open-loop plan, 10 poses x 0.5 s
horizons.PDMS: NAVSIM v1 non-reactive, 4 s (40 x 0.1 s), official navsim pdm_score via in-memory metric cache (PDMS_ADAPTER.md)

populations.dev F: 52 scenes / 365 units / 13 drives (A- stratum of 208-scene dev mechanism set; equal scene weights)
populations.P1-C E: 353 sampled scenes (2,191 eligible) / 2,436 units / 24 drives; Hajek

sign_checks.RN: recent_gt - normal (negative = fewer events). Verified: A2 table intervention=recent_gt reference=normal
sign_checks.RV: reverse@emb - gt_history (positive = more events). Verified: POPULATION_EFFECTS cond_a=reverse@emb cond_b=gt_history
sign_checks.C_GT: GT_NSRC - GT_REF; C_NAT: NAT_NSRC - NAT_REF (positive severe = harm of substituting the frozen Normal-source value for GT; i.e. GT->Normal-source substitution, opposite sign convention to RN). PDMS deltas are therefore negative for harm. Verified in ADD4_pdms_paired.csv intervention/reference columns and MATCHED_PREFIX_RESULTS.

interval_notes: All severe intervals are approximate drive-cluster t intervals (G-1 df) -- not exact sign-flip inversion; coverage only checked post hoc (supplement Sec. B, tab:coverage/tab:coverage_new).
RV E [1.90,5.40] and C_NAT E4 [2.38,5.57] were computed but WITHHELD in v04 (points only); C_GT E4 [0.88,5.75] retained only in supplement Sec. B text.

PDMS intervals: approximate drive-cluster t with ratio linearisation (pdms_paired_cluster_t.csv); re-derived exactly in this task from per-unit PDMS (A1_pdms_ci_recheck_20261023.csv). The original generating script is not on disk (NOT_FOUND); the vla0_work/pkg README states it was computed CPU-only.

FDE intervals: approximate drive-cluster t from P1-C analyze_p1c (secondary_fde5) and B2 MATCHED_PREFIX_RESULTS (fde5); no coverage check. Dev-F FDE has only a LOG-cluster interval from the R8 rerun (noted, not drive). ADE intervals: NOT computed anywhere.

computed_in_this_task.RV ADE/FDE/severe_tau: A1_rv_metric_decomposition_computed_20261023.csv by scripts/rv_metrics_20261023.py from raw records (dev: R8R9_raw_recovery/run_20261008/raw/exp8/records.jsonl; P1-C: P1C_new_log_replication/run_20261008/mech/prev_action_state_patching/records.jsonl) using the unchanged ra_a_metrics.metrics(). Checks (A1_rv_metric_checks_20261023.json): severe3 equals stored amplification in 730/730 dev and 4872/4872 P1-C rows; FDE max abs diff 0; reproduces stored RV severe3 28.628663 / 26.832955 / 3.646388 and P1-C RV FDE 2.584376 / 1.077372.

NOT_FOUND: PDMS for RV (any cohort): RV arms were never PDMS-scored
PDMS for development F (RN or RV): development plans were never PDMS-scored

discrepancy_flags: Development RN FDE/ADE (-4.06/-1.32) come from exp-7 records (outputs/action_history_causal/records.jsonl) as in the paper; the R8 rerun's recent_gt-normal FDE is -3.96 (different run).
C_NAT E4 severe_tau is non-monotone in tau (2 m: +2.56, 3 m: +3.98, 4 m: +3.51 pp); values are correct differences of rates, not an error, but should not be described as monotone attenuation.
